name: Yuoki
title: Yuoki Industries (Paranoidal)
author: YuokiTani; 2.0 port by jatmn; Paranoidal fork
description: Single Paranoidal fork of Yuoki Industries 1.2.23 and Yuoki Industries - Engines 1.2.9 (Factorio 2.0), with selected content of JATMN's Fixes & Integrations. Late-game continuation of the Paranoidal technology chain: N4/F7 materials from super-pure ores, transmutation, agronomy and trade, mechanical-force and steam energy. Version 9 keeps the portal from auto-updating it.
